title: KONGSBERG skal levere PROTECTOR-våpenstasjoner til Sverige og Finland
body:
Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace (“KONGSBERG”) har signert en kontrakt med Patria for levering av PROTECTOR fjernvåpenstasjoner på flere enn 300 Patria-kjøretøyer som det finske selskapet leverer til Sverige og Finland.
Kontrakten har en verdi på om lag 1,2 milliarder kroner.
KONGSBERG vil levere sine PROTECTOR RS4-våpenstasjoner til Patrias Common Armored Vehicle Systems (CAVS), som er et pansret og svært mobilt modulært ‘6 x 6’ kjøretøy. Patria kunngjorde 20. mars en kontrakt om å levere 321 slike CAVS-kjøretøyer til det svenske forsvaret.
Leveransene starter fra 2025 og varer inn i 2030-årene.
- I KONGSBERG er vi glade for å jobbe tett med Patria for å styrke forsvarsevnen til Sverige og Finland. Valget av felles militært utstyr blant nordiske land sikrer militær interoperabilitet og økt logistisk effektivitet. Det styrker også industrisamarbeidet til støtte for NATOs visjon om utskiftbart utstyr og forsyningssikkerhet, sier Eirik Lie, administrerende direktør i Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace.
- Denne avtalen gir en unik mulighet til å levere våpensystemer for å betjene behovene til flere land under én kontrakt og er nok en milepæl for det internasjonale CAVS-programmet. Effektiviteten og systemenhetsfordelene mellom partnernasjonene er enestående og ble allerede utnyttet i samarbeidet under utviklingsfasen, sier Esa Rautalinko, administrerende direktør i Patria.
Om PROTECTOR
PROTECTOR RS4 er designet og bygget for drift under tøffe forhold, med egenskaper som beskytter operative soldater ved hjelp av stabil og presis optikk og laser for å observere og oppdage mål. KONGSBERG er verdens ledende leverandør av Remote Weapon Systems (RWS) og har til dags dato levert mer enn 20 000 PROTECTOR-systemer til 28 nasjoner.
Patria og CAVS
Patria 6x6-kjøretøyet ble valgt som plattform for CAVS-samarbeidsprogrammet mellom flere europeiske land i 2021. CAVS-relaterte Patria 6x6-leveranser pågår til Latvia, Finland og Sverige, og kjøretøy er i operativ bruk. Tyskland ble med i programmet i april 2023.
Kongsberg Gruppen (OSE-ticker: KOG) er et internasjonalt, kunnskapsbasert konsern som leverer høyteknologiske systemer og løsninger til kunder innenfor et bredt spekter av markeder som forsvar, sikkerhet, maritim, energi, romfart, klimakartlegging og undervannsteknologi. Kongsberg Gruppen har over 13 500 medarbeidere i 39 land og hadde en samlet omsetning på 40,6 milliarder kroner i 2023.
Følg oss på: kongsberg.com, LinkedIn og X

title: KONGSBERG to deliver PROTECTOR remote weapon stations to Sweden and Finland
body:
Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace (“KONGSBERG”) has signed a contract with Patria for the delivery of PROTECTOR remote weapon stations on more than 300 Patria vehicles that the Finnish company is delivering to Sweden and Finland.
The contract has a value of about NOK 1.2 billion.
KONGSBERG will deliver its PROTECTOR RS4 weapon stations to Patria’s Common Armoured Vehicle Systems (CAVS), which is a well protected and highly mobile modular 6x6 vehicle. Patria announced on 20 March a contract to deliver 321 such CAVS vehicles to the Swedish armed forces. 
Deliveries will begin from 2025 and last into the 2030s.
“At KONGSBERG, we are pleased to be working closely with Patria to strengthen the defence capabilities of Sweden and Finland. The selection of common military equipment among Nordic countries ensures military interoperability and increased logistical efficiency. It also strengthens industry cooperation in support of NATO's vision for interchangeability of equipment and security of supply," said Eirik Lie, President of Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace.
“This agreement enables a unique opportunity to deliver weapon systems to serve the needs of multiple countries under one contract and is yet another milestone for the international CAVS programme. The efficiency and system unity benefits between the partner nations are unprecedented and were already utilised in the cooperation during the development phase,” said Esa Rautalinko, President and CEO of Patria.
About PROTECTOR
The PROTECTOR RS4 is designed and built for operation in harsh conditions, with capabilities that allow soldiers to operate from a protected position using stabilized precision optics and laser to observe and detect targets.
KONGSBERG is the world’s leading provider of Remote Weapon Systems (RWS) and has to date delivered more than 20.000 PROTECTOR Remote Weapon Systems to 28 nations. 
Patria and CAVS
The Patria 6x6 vehicle was chosen as the platform for the CAVS collaboration programme between several European countries in 2021. CAVS-related Patria 6x6 deliveries are ongoing to Latvia, Finland and Sweden, and vehicles are in operational use. Germany joined the programme in April 2023.
KONGSBERG (OSE ticker: KOG) is an international, knowledge-based group that supplies high-technology systems and solutions to customers in a wide range of markets such as defence, security, maritime, energy, aerospace, climate mapping and subsea technology. KONGSBERG has more than 13,500 employees in 39 countries and has a total turnover of NOK 40.6 billion in 2023.

body:
Smartoptics Group AS (the "Company") has been notified that Coretech AS has
pledged 3 000 000 shares in the Company.
Coretech AS is a company closely associated with Thomas Ramm, chair of the
Company's board of directors. Please see the attached PDMR form for further

title: Himalaya Shipping Ltd. (HSHP) files 2023 Annual Report on Form 20-F
body:
Hamilton, Bermuda, March 27, 2024
Himalaya Shipping Ltd. (the "Company") has filed its Annual Report on Form 20-F
for the Year Ended December 31, 2023 (the "2023 Annual Report") with the U.S.
Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") on March 27, 2024. The report is
attached to this release.
The Company's 2023 Annual Report can be downloaded from the SEC's website
(http://www.sec.gov) and is also available on the Company's website
(https://www.himalaya-shipping.com). Hard copies of the Company's 2023 Annual
Report can be obtained, free of charge, upon request by writing to us at:
Himalaya Shipping Ltd.
S.E. Pearman Building, 2nd Floor,
9 Par-la-Ville Road,
Hamilton HM11,
Bermuda
This information is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to section 5
-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.
For queries, please contact:
Herman Billung, Contracted CEO
Telephone +47918 31590
